temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor at the funeral and hears Shirley say it has been tough and that she keeps wondering if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was a caring professional who might be grieving the patient's death, but she did not know the depth of Shirley's distress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed from general awareness of Shirley's sadness to recognizing that Shirley is deeply affected and may be questioning whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is deeply grieving the patient's death and may carry some self-doubt or responsibility about the care provided.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort and reassure Shirley by emphasizing the good care they provided and offering support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During coffee, Sara hears Shirley explicitly say she feels responsible and wonders whether pushing for a different approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and possibly feeling some responsibility, and Sara wanted to better understand Shirley's feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and intensified: Shirley's sense of responsibility is not vague; she openly feels personally burdened by the treatment outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley feels significant guilt and responsibility for the patient's outcome and is struggling to accept the decisions they made.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Compassion, concern, and a desire to relieve Shirley's burden
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Shirley that they made the best decisions with the information available and encourage her not to carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara sees Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive, then hears Shirley admit she holds back because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving, felt responsible, and had been emotionally reserved, possibly suppressing her feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara learns that Shirley's reserve is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, not by a lack of trust in Sara.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley wants to be more open but needs reassurance that expressing emotion is healthy and not a sign of weakness.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, gentle, and determined to help
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings and provide a safe, supportive space for her to do so.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong, and Shirley says it was a bit much but that she knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worried that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and could have strained their friendship or pushed Shirley too far.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Sara's worry is relieved: Shirley understood Sara's intent, accepted the apology, and still values their conversations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship remains intact and that Shirley welcomes continued support and open communication.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend the friendship, remain supportive, and communicate with more gentleness going forward.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems to be doing better and hears Shirley say she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support; Shirley agrees to spend time together over the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley had been improving and felt hopeful that her support was helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and deepened: Sara learns that Shirley attributes her improvement to their talks and support, and Shirley is open to spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is improving, values her support, and that their relationship can extend beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend more time together outside of work.
